latin: Dictum Apostoli dicentis Deus uult omnes homines saluos fieri positiue de uoluntate beneplaciti antecedente intelligenda est.
translation: The Apostle's saying, 'God wills all men to be saved,' is to be understood positively, of the antecedent will of good pleasure.
